title: Ghapoo Yadav v. State of Madhya Pradesh

content.caseIdentity: Ghapoo Yadav v. State of Madhya Pradesh, (2003) 3 SCC 528
content.holding: Deconstructed the four cumulative ingredients of Exception 4 (sudden fight) to Section 101: absence of premeditation, sudden fight in heat of passion upon a sudden quarrel, and the strict absence of undue advantage or cruelty.
content.relevance: Leading authority on Exception 4 sudden fight defense.
